text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, when I visited the library—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Please... I'm counting on you!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
O-Opera O-san?! Not here in a place like 
this...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, pardon me. Bad library manners are 
hardly aesthetic... Whew.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Please... I'm counting on you...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Um, well, their voices did get quieter, 
but...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer-kun. Yes, why don't you lend a 
hand as well?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
She's the wise one who knows the song I've 
been searching for.
choice_data_list: One who knows song... a sage...?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Th-That's a bit harsh to say...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—To summarize the situation before things 
get too confusing...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seemed T.M. Opera O came to ask Zenno 
Rob Roy for play recommendations.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Her consulting skills are top-notch! I 
want to invite her to be my dramaturg!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: N-No way... You're exaggerating.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...I-I just like books, that's all. You 
really don't need to ask so politelyâ

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Rob Roy-kun.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ? Yes?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: I am beautiful.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Huh? Y-Yes. That's, right... isn't it?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Then no more words are needed.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Zenno Rob Roy is confused. It looks 
like she could use a helping hand.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
There's no "in other words" about it. 
"Value should be judged fairly" —don't you 
agree?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Rob Roy-kun. Your knowledge of books is 
exceptionally profound. It is a skill 
truly worthy of praise and pride.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
It is never something to be unfairly 
belittled. Even if that belittlement comes 
from yourself.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
choice_data_list: Opera O is right about that.
Opera O is right about that, isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...Both of you.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
That is why I ask of you once more. Could 
you tell me of a play... worthy of me?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...Yes! Please let me pick out the best 
book for you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And then, Zenno Rob Roy recommended two 
theatrical plays to me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The first book the two of them began 
reading was—
choice_data_list: The Story of the Racing God
A story of a hero who saves the people.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, what a coincidence. I was just 
thinking of reading that book first, too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Deeply engrossed in reading alongside T.M. 
Opera O—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: —Thou, what dost thou desire of me?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Speed, then that is fine too. ...I have 
high hopes for you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...T.M. Opera O had caught some mysterious 
fad, but it seemed to have had a positive 
effect on her running.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, what a coincidence. I was just 
thinking of reading that book first, too!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...Opera O-san! I brought a different book 
today!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Oops... Thank you. Fufu, I'm looking 
forward to reading this book, too.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I simply wished to read a new heroic 
saga. —The heroes that people yearn for 
take many different forms.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Just as the hero of her dreams 
differs from the "Supreme Overlord" I 
strive to be.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Reading the book seemed to have granted 
T.M. Opera O some kind of realization.
